evidence: The multilayer ﬁlms were grown by subsequently applying m cycles of SrO and n cycles of TiO 2, where the deposition is started with a SrO sublayer. By changing the cycle numbers n and m the thicknesses of individual sublayers can be adjusted in order to reliably control the Sr/Ti ratio of the ﬁlm. The growth behavior of these ﬁlms was investigated on untreated single crystalline Si (001) wafers, as well as on Ru electrodes.
